查看原文（22行） ````text > Go language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). gopls — the official Go language server. > 中文：DSH 的 Go LSP「即插即用」语言包 —— 装上本包，.go 文件即可用 `lsp` 工具做代码导航。 This pack is one Cordis configuration plugin: it registers a configured `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp` with the server command, launch arguments, and extension mapping for Go. It implements **no LSP protocol** — the shared base does: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp` (the seam) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` (the model-facing `lsp` tool with `goToDefinition` / `findReferences` / `goToImplementation` / `hover`). Twelve packs reuse one unchanged base. ## Installing the language server ```bash go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest # distro: brew install gopls | apt install gopls | choco install gopls ``` `gopls` lands in `$(go env GOPATH)/bin`; make sure that directory (or `~/go/bin`) is on `PATH`. > ⚠️ The plugin itself **never downloads or installs the server binary** — matching the > upstream anthropics LSP plugins, the server is an external prerequisite. The plugin only > resolves and launches it. ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-go/src/index.ts:28-46](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-go/src/index.ts#L28-L46) provider、注入依赖、默认命令与单扩展表。
查看原文（19行） ```text /** Cordis plugin name for loader diagnostics. */ export const name = 'lsp-go' /** Services required by the shared LSP base this pack assembles. */ export const inject = ['fs', 'lsp', 'subprocess'] /** Stable provider id reserved on `ctx.lsp` by this pack. */ export const PROVIDER_ID = 'go' /** Default server command (absolute path or PATH-resolved executable, no shell). */ export const DEFAULT_COMMAND = 'gopls' /** Default launch arguments. */ export const DEFAULT_ARGS: readonly string[] = [] /** Default lowercase leading-dot extension → LSP language id table. */ export const DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE: Readonly> = { ".go": "go" } ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-go/src/index.ts:152-160](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-go/src/index.ts#L152-L160) 委托 LspStdio。 ```text export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise { const server = resolveServerConfig(config) try { // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass. const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } }) await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig) return ``` #### 缺口 - 真实Go module中的导航正确性与初次索引负担缺少对照。 **影响：**不能由gopls启动参数推断结果质量。 **进一步探讨：**以带已知跨包位置的Go module对照四项导航与索引资源。 ### Q02 · 缺服降级是否保留自定义扩展并准确区分故障？ **研究主题：**工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 resolveServerConfig 合并用户扩展与命令等覆盖。apply 的 catch 包括 LspStdio.Config 与 apply 故障；catch 中统一警告 gopls unavailable，并以 DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE 创建 fallback。由此配置/注册问题也可能被归为缺服，而且用户自定义扩展在 fallback 中失去路由。另一方面 resolveServerConfig 在 try 外，若此处抛错仍可能中断加载，与注释的绝不崩溃说法有边界。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-go/src/index.ts:103-118](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-go/src/index.ts#L103-L118) 默认与用户覆盖合并。
查看原文（16行） ```text export function resolveServerConfig(config: Config): ResolvedServerConfig { const server: ResolvedServerConfig = { command: config.command ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND, args: config.args ?? [...DEFAULT_ARGS], extensionToLanguage: { ...DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, ...(config.extensionToLanguage ?? {}) }, } if (config.env !== undefined) server.env = config.env if (config.initializationOptions !== undefined) server.initializationOptions = config.initializationOptions if (config.configuration !== undefined) server.configuration = config.configuration if (config.maxMessageBytes !== undefined) server.maxMessageBytes = config.maxMessageBytes if (config.maxStderrBytes !== undefined) server.maxStderrBytes = config.maxStderrBytes if (config.maxDocumentBytes !== undefined) server.maxDocumentBytes = config.maxDocumentBytes if (config.shutdownTimeoutMs !== undefined) server.shutdownTimeoutMs = config.shutdownTimeoutMs if (config.killGraceMs !== undefined) server.killGraceMs = config.killGraceMs return server } ```

' + 'Install the language server (see the pack README) and reload the profile or session.' return Promise.reject(new LspError(message, 'LSP_UNAVAILABLE')) } } /** Extract a stable message from an unknown load-time failure. */ function failureMessage(error: unknown): string { if (error instanceof Error) return error.message return String(error) } /** * Register the configured stdio provider for the language, or a structured * no-server fallback when the executable cannot be resolved at load. * * The pack never crashes the session: an unresolvable server only disables * this language routing and surfaces `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` on queries. * @param ctx - the plugin context (must inject `fs`, `lsp`, `subprocess`). * @param config - the resolved pack configuration. */ export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise { const server = resolveServerConfig(config) try { // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass. const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } }) await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig) return } catch (error) { const reason = failureMessage(error) console.warn('[' + name + '] ' + DEFAULT_COMMAND + ' unavailable at load: ' + reason) ctx.effect(() => { const dispose = ctx.lsp.registerProvider( new UnavailableProvider(DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, reason), ) return () => dispose() }, name + '.unavailableFallback') ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-go/README.md:30-54](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-go/README.md#L30-L54) 作者声明 lazy start/缺服降级/覆盖。
查看原文（25行） ````text ## How the pack works - **Lazy start**: the server process is **not** started at load. `lsp-stdio` launches it lazily on the first matching query and keeps one process per workspace. - **No-server fallback**: if the executable cannot be resolved, the pack still loads; every `lsp` query for these extensions fails with a structured `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error naming the command — the rest of the session is unaffected. - **Config overrides**: every default below can be overridden from the composition row, e.g. a server installed at a non-standard path: ```yaml - id: lsp-go name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-go' config: command: /absolute/path/to/gopls args: - --stdio extensionToLanguage: '.xyz': custom-language-id maxDocumentBytes: 8000000 ``` All fields of the `servers` table documented in the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` README are accepted (`command`, `args`, `env`, `extensionToLanguage`, `initializationOptions`, `configuration`, byte/time bounds). ````

> Go language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). gopls — the official Go language server.
> 中文：DSH 的 Go LSP「即插即用」语言包 —— 装上本包，.go 文件即可用 `lsp` 工具做代码导航。

This pack is one Cordis configuration plugin: it registers a configured
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp` with the server command, launch
arguments, and extension mapping for Go. It implements **no LSP protocol** —
the shared base does: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp` (the seam) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` (the
model-facing `lsp` tool with `goToDefinition` / `findReferences` / `goToImplementation` /
`hover`). Twelve packs reuse one unchanged base.

## Installing the language server

```bash
go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
# distro:  brew install gopls   |   apt install gopls   |   choco install gopls
```

`gopls` lands in `$(go env GOPATH)/bin`; make sure that directory (or `~/go/bin`) is on `PATH`.

> ⚠️ The plugin itself **never downloads or installs the server binary** — matching the
> upstream anthropics LSP plugins, the server is an external prerequisite. The plugin only
> resolves and launches it.

## Supported extensions

| `.go` | `go` |

## How the pack works

- **Lazy start**: the server process is **not** started at load. `lsp-stdio` launches it
  lazily on the first matching query and keeps one process per workspace.
- **No-server fallback**: if the executable cannot be resolved, the pack still loads;
  every `lsp` query for these extensions fails with a structured `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error
  naming the command — the rest of the session is unaffected.
- **Config overrides**: every default below can be overridden from the composition row,
  e.g. a server installed at a non-standard path:

```yaml
- id: lsp-go
  name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-go'
  config:
    command: /absolute/path/to/gopls
    args:
      - --stdio
    extensionToLanguage:
      '.xyz': custom-language-id
    maxDocumentBytes: 8000000
```

All fields of the `servers` table documented in the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` README are
accepted (`command`, `args`, `env`, `extensionToLanguage`, `initializationOptions`,
`configuration`, byte/time bounds).

## Mounting

1. Mount the shared base **once** (the `lsp` service, the `lsp` tool, and a
   filesystem/subprocess pair for the same execution world) — ready-made snippet in
   `examples/base-composition.cordis.yml` of the dsh-lsp-packs repo.
2. Install the pack (its `cordis.yml` is the `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the row inserts
   itself):

```bash
dsh plugin add @dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-go    # published name
dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-go  # or a local checkout
```

or compose the row directly (name resolved from the installed package):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: lsp-go
      name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-go'
```

pnpm vitest run --dir dsh-lsp-go   # or from the repo root: pnpm test

## 设计要点

- **配置层而不是协议层**：包只声明 `servers` 表（command / args / extensionToLanguage / 边界参数），协议与进程编排全部交给 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio`，模型侧工具由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` 提供——12 个包对底座零改动（验收标准 3）。
- **懒启动**：加载时不拉起 server，首次匹配查询才 spawn（与上游行为一致）。
- **Config 覆盖**：`Config` 允许覆盖 `command` / `args` / `env` / `extensionToLanguage` 等全部字段（默认与 README 一致），便于用户本机路径不同的场景。
- **No-server fallback**：加载期解析可执行文件失败时，注册占位 provider，查询统一抛 `LSP_UNAVAILABLE`，保证“未装 server 时不影响其他工具”。

 * dsh-lsp-go — Go language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness.
 *
 * One language pack = one npm package that registers a configured
 * `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp`. The pack ships the
 * server command, launch arguments, and the extension → language-id table
 * for its language; the deployment composes the shared LSP base once (the
 * `lsp` service, the `lsp` tool, and a filesystem/subprocess pair for the
 * same execution world) and every language pack reuses it unchanged.
 *
 * The server is NOT launched at load: `lsp-stdio` starts processes lazily on
 * the first matching query. When the server executable cannot be resolved,
 * the pack still loads and every query fails with a structured
 * `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error naming the missing command, so the rest of the
 * session keeps working.
 *
 * Namespace plugin (named exports, no default export).
 * @module @dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-go
 */

import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
import { LspError, LspProviderId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp'
import type { LspProvider, LspProviderQuery, LspQueryResult } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp'
import * as LspStdio from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio'
import type { LspLocalServerConfig } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio'

/** Cordis plugin name for loader diagnostics. */
export const name = 'lsp-go'

/** Services required by the shared LSP base this pack assembles. */
export const inject = ['fs', 'lsp', 'subprocess']

/** Stable provider id reserved on `ctx.lsp` by this pack. */
export const PROVIDER_ID = 'go'

/** Default server command (absolute path or PATH-resolved executable, no shell). */
export const DEFAULT_COMMAND = 'gopls'

/** Default launch arguments. */
export const DEFAULT_ARGS: readonly string[] = []

/** Default lowercase leading-dot extension → LSP language id table. */
export const DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
    ".go": "go"
}

/**
 * Pack configuration. Every field is optional and overrides the pack default;
 * leaving a field unset keeps the README-documented default. This is how a
 * user points the pack at a server installed at a non-standard path.
 */
export interface Config {
  /** Override the server command (absolute path or PATH name). */
  command?: string
  /** Override the launch arguments (replaces the default list entirely). */
  args?: string[]
  /** Extra environment variables merged on top of the scrubbed ambient env. */
  env?: Record<string, string>
  /** Extra extension → language-id entries merged on top of the defaults. */
  extensionToLanguage?: Record<string, string>
  /** Static `initialize` options forwarded to the server. */
  initializationOptions?: unknown
  /** Static answer to every `workspace/configuration` item. */
  configuration?: unknown
  /** Largest single framed message accepted from the server (bytes). */
  maxMessageBytes?: number
  /** Largest stderr tail retained for diagnostics (bytes). */
  maxStderrBytes?: number
  /** Largest source file this host will open (bytes). */
  maxDocumentBytes?: number
  /** Graceful shutdown/exit budget before escalation (ms). */
  shutdownTimeoutMs?: number
  /** Request-cancel and SIGTERM→SIGKILL grace (ms). */
  killGraceMs?: number
}

export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
  command: z.string(),
  args: z.array(String),
  env: z.dict(String),
  extensionToLanguage: z.dict(String),
  initializationOptions: z.any(),
  configuration: z.any(),
  maxMessageBytes: z.number(),
  maxStderrBytes: z.number(),
  maxDocumentBytes: z.number(),
  shutdownTimeoutMs: z.number(),
  killGraceMs: z.number(),
})

/**
 * The server entry this pack always fills completely: `command`, `args`, and
 * `extensionToLanguage` are guaranteed present (defaults or user overrides).
 */
export type ResolvedServerConfig = LspLocalServerConfig & {
  command: string
  args: string[]
  extensionToLanguage: Record<string, string>
}

/** Merge the pack defaults with the user overrides into one stdio server entry. */
export function resolveServerConfig(config: Config): ResolvedServerConfig {
  const server: ResolvedServerConfig = {
    command: config.command ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND,
    args: config.args ?? [...DEFAULT_ARGS],
    extensionToLanguage: { ...DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, ...(config.extensionToLanguage ?? {}) },
  }
  if (config.env !== undefined) server.env = config.env
  if (config.initializationOptions !== undefined) server.initializationOptions = config.initializationOptions
  if (config.configuration !== undefined) server.configuration = config.configuration
  if (config.maxMessageBytes !== undefined) server.maxMessageBytes = config.maxMessageBytes
  if (config.maxStderrBytes !== undefined) server.maxStderrBytes = config.maxStderrBytes
  if (config.maxDocumentBytes !== undefined) server.maxDocumentBytes = config.maxDocumentBytes
  if (config.shutdownTimeoutMs !== undefined) server.shutdownTimeoutMs = config.shutdownTimeoutMs
  if (config.killGraceMs !== undefined) server.killGraceMs = config.killGraceMs
  return server
}

/** A provider that keeps extension routing alive while the server is missing. */
class UnavailableProvider implements LspProvider {
  readonly id = LspProviderId(PROVIDER_ID)
  readonly extensionToLanguage: Readonly<Record<string, string>>

  constructor(extensions: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, private readonly reason: string) {
    this.extensionToLanguage = { ...extensions }
  }

  query(_request: LspProviderQuery): Promise<LspQueryResult> {
    const message =
      'language server for ' + PROVIDER_ID + ' is unavailable: ' + this.reason + '. '
      + 'Install the language server (see the pack README) and reload the profile or session.'
    return Promise.reject(new LspError(message, 'LSP_UNAVAILABLE'))
  }
}

/** Extract a stable message from an unknown load-time failure. */
function failureMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message
  return String(error)
}

/**
 * Register the configured stdio provider for the language, or a structured
 * no-server fallback when the executable cannot be resolved at load.
 *
 * The pack never crashes the session: an unresolvable server only disables
 * this language routing and surfaces `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` on queries.
 * @param ctx - the plugin context (must inject `fs`, `lsp`, `subprocess`).
 * @param config - the resolved pack configuration.
 */
export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise<void> {
  const server = resolveServerConfig(config)
  try {
    // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default
    // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the
    // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass.
    const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } })
    await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig)
    return
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = failureMessage(error)
    console.warn('[' + name + '] ' + DEFAULT_COMMAND + ' unavailable at load: ' + reason)
    ctx.effect(() => {
      const dispose = ctx.lsp.registerProvider(
        new UnavailableProvider(DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, reason),
      )
      return () => dispose()
    }, name + '.unavailableFallback')
  }
}
